tasks.title: Approval/notification UX slice: scope-explicit receipts, folded cards, match diagnosis, repeat escalation
tasks.objective: Receipt copy keys on repeatableForFutureRuns ('Approved for this run only' + next-run sentence on the jobId branch; legacy mode fallback); completed-but-degraded runs emit ONE 'Completed with limits' card and suppress the standalone setup card (setupNotified threaded from finalization); prompts/denials render Approved-pattern vs Attempted-command through the sanitizer gates and split unmatched vs not-granted wording; the promotion hint becomes 'Asked N times in D days' via firstAskedAt.
acceptance_criteria: allow-once receipt reads 'Approved for this run only' (+ 'It will ask again next run' only with a jobId); durable receipt unchanged; decisions without provenance fields fall back to mode and keep working

a completed run with a degraded step yields exactly one card ('Completed with limits' + degraded line) with the standalone setup card suppressed for that fingerprint; a run that died on the blocker yields the setup card only; blocker persistence/readiness events untouched

a RunCommand miss with rules renders the approved pattern (sanitizePermissionText) and attempted command (sanitizePermissionCommandText, secret-bearing input shows the sanitizer replacement); a tool with no rules renders not-granted wording; the two wordings are distinct in permission-decision-message

the escalation line 'Asked N times in D days, each approved once only. Approve permanently?' replaces the promotion hint at the existing threshold, with firstAskedAt propagated through the classifier path; per-agent keying documented in code
the locked approval option set is unchanged (no timed grants, no new options)

required_tests.id: permission receipts > says approved for this run only and that a scheduled job will ask again next run
required_tests.command: VITEST_JUNIT=1 FORGE_TEST_ID={id} npx vitest run -c vitest.unit.config.ts {path} --outputFile {report}
